integrity.claim_scope: Minimum four-vertex power-dominating configurations, one-vertex jump and adjacent slides, all-pairs distance and locality-penalty distributions
integrity.evidence_kind: Complete finite enumeration with independently implemented checking programs and explicit graph isomorphism

limitations: Exact finite result about the 30-vertex Tutte–Coxeter graph, not a general theorem about all cubic cages or generalized quadrangles.
All relocation paths keep exactly four sensors; paths allowing extra sensors have not been classified.
Historical priority is conditional on the indexed and inspected literature; an unindexed equivalent may exist.
No independent external audit or formal proof-system verification has been performed.
title: Nine-move locality excess in minimum power-domination relocation on the Tutte eight-cage
